title: Tiny matched-history D4 schedule pilot

program_alignment.central_question: Can a causal just-in-time commit/defer schedule preserve useful D4 herald information when both syndrome and herald readout are noisy?
program_alignment.scientific_layer: Fault-tolerance pilot under an explicitly phenomenological/projector-level translated D4 channel.
program_alignment.epistemic_role: Exploratory implementation-and-resolution pilot, not a threshold, scaling, superiority, or hardware fault-tolerance study.
program_alignment.information_value: It is the smallest matrix that simultaneously exercises every schedule, both public information modes, a clean-herald schedule contrast, and a noisy-herald contrast on identical histories.

question_and_hypotheses.question: On paper L=2 and five readout rounds, can the translated D4 generator and private scorer produce integrity-clean paired schedule outcomes with enough nontrivial events to justify a larger comparison?
question_and_hypotheses.smallest_claim: The translated stochastic path is operational and the registered finite pilot either resolves a preliminary paired direction or reports that its event/risk resolution is insufficient.
question_and_hypotheses.H1: Under syndrome readout noise, Lyons-Brown JIT changes unconditional logical failure or commit diagnostics relative to immediate and fixed-delay-1 on the same histories.
question_and_hypotheses.H1_null: The registered pilot resolves no paired JIT difference; this does not establish schedule equivalence.
question_and_hypotheses.H3: Adding the registered categorical herald record changes unconditional logical failure or commit diagnostics within at least one online schedule when herald readout is noisy.
question_and_hypotheses.H3_null: The registered pilot resolves no paired mode difference; this does not show that heralds are useless.
question_and_hypotheses.censored_outcome: Any provenance, normalization, causality, action-binding, replay, denominator, or zero-control failure censors all performance interpretation.

research_basis.external_structure: Lyons-Brown repeated detectors, time-directed readout faults, causal commit/defer, absorber/ungauging lifecycle, and matched-history comparison as audited locally.
research_basis.project_translation: Researcher-approved D4 phenomenological/projector-level replacement with vacuum/m_flux/e_charge, none/blue/green reports, action-bound post-flux transition, and ground-state-relative logical scoring.
research_basis.claim_boundary: Not an exact D(S3) circuit reproduction; not a Jing perfect-measurement threshold reuse; no threshold, crossing, scaling, optimality, or fault-tolerance claim.

physical_and_observation_model.geometry: Paper-normalized periodic D4 coloured honeycomb at L=2, the verified translated-interface size.
physical_and_observation_model.time: Five public readout rounds and four between-round hidden transitions.
physical_and_observation_model.data_transition: Independent registered local phenomenological D4 transition injections with rate p_data between adjacent rounds, followed by deterministic action-conditioned post-flux evolution when a schedule commits.
physical_and_observation_model.first_public_record: Adjacent-round binary syndrome detectors plus categorical none/blue/green herald readout; signal-only, causal, and free of private support or truth fields.
physical_and_observation_model.second_public_record: Action-conditioned full-binary charge/vacuum record bound to its own public flux action and available only after that action.
physical_and_observation_model.public_charge_action: Relation-free full-binary blue/green charge recovery using only the completed public record.
physical_and_observation_model.private_boundary: Hidden transition labels, physical support, winding truth, residual truth and logical scoring never enter a public schedule or decoder request.
physical_and_observation_model.logical_loss: Unconditional Boolean union: one if any completed physical-plus-correction history contains a ground-state-relative nontrivial winding or terminal uncleared residual; abort, timeout, malformed completion or missing score counts as failure.
physical_and_observation_model.denominator: Every registered independent history in its cell, without post-selection on event count, convergence, completion or decoder success.

design.independent_unit: One master-seeded hidden/public five-round history, evaluated under all eight arms; uncertainty resamples whole histories.

timing_and_information_budget.online: Immediate, fixed-delay-1 and JIT receive only the causal prefix at invocation and share the same inner decoder, physical history, action semantics and final scoring window.
timing_and_information_budget.offline: Offline receives the completed visible history and is an explicitly noncausal diagnostic reference, not a matched operational schedule.
timing_and_information_budget.mode_difference: The only intended syndrome_only/heralded difference is access to the declared categorical herald record.

cells.role: Exact zero-noise and replay control; excluded from stochastic effect comparisons.
Schedule contrast with noisy data/syndrome and perfect categorical herald readout.
Joint schedule and information-mode contrast under noisy syndrome and herald readout.

design.seed_rule: seed = 905190000 + 100000 * cell_index + history_index, with cell_index in manifest order and zero-based history_index.

primary: paired JIT-minus-immediate and JIT-minus-fixed-delay-1 logical-failure differences within each public mode
paired heralded-minus-syndrome-only logical-failure differences within each online schedule
diagnostic: false-commit and missed-or-late-commit indicators computed privately after public actions freeze
first-commit and terminal latency, including right-censoring at the final round
active spacetime volume, public measurement count, decoder invocations and deterministic work counters
observables_and_analysis.arm_uncertainty: Pointwise 95% Wilson intervals for Bernoulli risks; no simultaneous-coverage claim.
observables_and_analysis.paired_uncertainty: Pointwise 95% percentile intervals from 2000 fixed-seed nonparametric bootstrap resamples of independent complete histories. Bootstrap seed 905192000; never resample schedule arms separately.
observables_and_analysis.comparison_rule: A larger confirmatory study may be proposed only if at least one preregistered online paired logical-risk contrast has absolute difference at least 0.05 and its pointwise paired interval excludes zero, with every integrity gate passing. This is a promotion trigger, not a superiority claim.
observables_and_analysis.null_rule: If no trigger passes, report the finite pilot as unresolved or negative and do not adapt rates, add histories or select another contrast post hoc.

preflight_and_integrity_gates: Every frozen file hash and required J1-E4B status matches before construction.
All hidden transition and public readout rows normalize exactly; zero and deterministic limiting cases replay.
The zero-control cell has no readout faults, no spurious logical failure, and bit-identical replay in every arm.
One immutable visible-history digest and one private physical key bind all eight arms of an independent unit.
Online prefixes exclude future and truth-sidecar fields; offline is explicitly marked noncausal.
Every second public record is bound to its own completed first action; wrong-action substitution fails closed.
Public charge action sees no relation, support, effective-string, truth, winding or sentinel field.
Both modes and all four schedules produce one terminal row per history; missing, aborted or timed-out rows remain in the denominator as failures.
Replay preserves public requests, actions, completion state, private score and registered keys.

Each stochastic cell contains at least 16 histories with a nonempty detector event and every online schedule invokes on at least 8 histories; otherwise the pilot is reported non-informative without expansion.

compute_budget.preflight: At most 32 deterministic synthetic histories and 256 arm evaluations before production histories are armed.
compute_budget.pilot: Exactly 272 independent histories and 2176 arm evaluations; no adaptive extension.
compute_budget.uncertainty: Exactly 2000 whole-history bootstrap replicates per registered paired contrast after integrity passes.
compute_budget.caps: Ten CPU minutes, 2 GiB resident memory and 50 MiB combined raw/analysis output. Censor rather than exceed any cap.

acceptance_and_stop_rules.registration_tick: Create and lint this contract and its durable plan/wiki/report pointers only. Generate zero histories, run zero arms and produce zero bootstrap replicates.
acceptance_and_stop_rules.preflight_release: Production sampling may begin only after a machine-readable preflight reports every provenance, normalization, causality, anti-leakage, action-binding, denominator and replay gate passed.
acceptance_and_stop_rules.fail_closed: On any integrity failure, source mismatch, unsupported physical field or cap violation, write a censored result and do not start or continue pilot sampling.
acceptance_and_stop_rules.fixed_stop: After the registered 272 histories, analyze every cell and comparison once. Do not tune rates, select favorable schedules or add histories in this pilot.
acceptance_and_stop_rules.allowed_claim: Finite L=2, five-round phenomenological pilot feasibility and preliminary paired directions with pointwise uncertainty.

planned_outputs.figure: Optional only after analysis if it materially clarifies paired schedule/mode differences.

preflight_execution.implemented_interface: scripts/d4_integrated_history.py composes five-round hidden D4 histories and causal public first records, generates action-conditioned full-binary second records through the remediated R6AF boundary, keeps support/relations private, derives winding-or-terminal-residual Boolean-union loss without an external logical label, scores zero-event arms without a fabricated action, treats each later full-snapshot decoder output as the cumulative Pauli-frame estimate while collapsing same-round duplicate cluster callbacks, and retains a valid noisy record rejected by the static periodic decoder as eight unconditional failed-closed arm rows.

production_execution.stop_rule_applied: The clean-herald JIT arm reached only seven invoking histories per public mode, below the preregistered minimum of eight. The pilot is non-informative and censored before uncertainty analysis.

next_operation: None within J6: do not bootstrap, adapt rates, add histories, or interpret schedule/mode risk from this censored pilot. Any replacement requires a separately registered scope and budget.
